free_tier.stated: Three days of any VPS tariff or of S3 object storage at no charge, with the campaign valid until 31 January 2027. The trial requires confirming a phone number and activating the period from the control panel. Two limits apply inside the trial: SMTP is unavailable on trial VPS tariffs, and channel throughput is capped at 10 Mbit/s. Trial S3 storage is capped at 500 GB. Files and settings are kept for seven days after the trial ends, and the provider's own VPS landing page describes the same offer in its meta description as free for a period of up to 12 months, which the body of the page contradicts.

egress.terms: Trial VPS tariffs have channel throughput limited to 10 Mbit/s (from the trial conditions); the line 'unlimited traffic with VPS rental' is the paid VPS tariff's feature on the paid VPS page, not a trial term. No overage price is published.

interface_detail: S3 API, per the S3 storage page: "Совместимость с S3 API"
tooling: no client is named on https://help.sweb.ru/ob6ektnoe-hranilishe-s3-principy-raboty-i-vozmozhnosti_1505.html: "привычных инструментах"
chaining: The S3 half of the same trial is the more useful part: 500 GB of S3-API-compatible object storage for three days at no charge, with the S3 product page charging stored volume only and not charging egress or read and write operations, which is enough to measure a transfer path rather than to run one.

identity_cost.detail: phone: the campaign page requires confirming a phone number before the three-day trial is activated, and the page says only 'confirm a phone number', so whether a foreign number can confirm is not established in the record. No card requirement and no hold are stated, and the trial is activated from the control panel rather than by a payment method: unknown whether one is ever requested.

evidence.proved: campaign page: three days of VPS or S3 free, valid until 31 January 2027, phone confirmation required, 'SMTP is not available on VPS tariffs within the trial period and channel throughput is limited to 10 Mbit', trial S3 capped at 500 GB, data kept 7 days, quoted and translated
the VPS landing page's meta description offers a free virtual server 'for a period of up to 12 months' while the page body describes a 3-day period, a contradiction on the provider's own site
paid VPS is advertised from RUB 0.30 an hour, which is about RUB 219 a month at 730 hours, arithmetic shown; the page also states foreign VPS locations with the Netherlands named as the main one
an API to manage the server is listed
evidence.quote: Программный интерфейс приложения (API) для управления сервером

evidence.proved: the provider's S3 object storage is S3 API compatible
evidence.quote: Совместимость с S3 API позволяет легко переносить данные и выстраивать гибкие процессы на привычных инструментах.

evidence.proved: S3 storage is charged on stored volume only; egress and read/write operations are not charged
evidence.quote: Плата взимается только за объем хранения. Не тарифицируются: исходящий трафик, операции чтения (GET, HEAD, LIST) и записи (PUT, POST, PATCH).

evidence.proved: the S3 trial has the same resources as paid, capped at 500 GB
evidence.quote: Предоставляются те же мощности и ресурсы, что и на платной основе. Максимальный объем дискового пространства, включая зарезервированный объем и дополнительное дисковое пространство, ограничен 500 Гб.

evidence.proved: trial VPS tariffs have no SMTP and channel throughput limited to 10 Mbit
evidence.quote: Для тарифов VPS в рамках тестового периода не доступен SMTP и ограничена пропускная способность канала до 10 Мбит.

evidence.proved: the page refers only to familiar tools, naming none
evidence.quote: Совместимость с S3 API позволяет легко переносить данные и выстраивать гибкие процессы на привычных инструментах.

notes: The 10 Mbit/s cap is the number that matters and it is buried in the conditions section rather than the features list. The 12-month claim in the meta description is search-engine text, not an offer: the campaign page and the help centre both say three days for VPS. Not established: whether the trial is once per person, and whether a foreign number can confirm (the page says only 'confirm a phone number').

shape.note: the trial is of any tariff in the catalogue, so the shape is the tariff chosen; the cheapest listed tariff is advertised from RUB 0.30 an hour
